slots.dense-layered-architecture/title:
Separate shared platform controls from domain delivery
so each release has clear ownership and observable evidence
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience-wh: Make work and decisions legible to the people who use the service.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services-why/: Keep workflow rules and integrations modular enough to change safely.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation-wh: Provide shared capabilities that can be measured and operated consistently.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/governance-ba: GOVERNANCE  •  decision rights  •  exception review  •  release evidence
slots.dense-layered-architecture/security-band: SHARED CONTROLS  •  identity and access  •  auditability  •  data protection
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/in: Capture request context, confirm completeness and show the requester what happens next.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/wo: Bring evidence and policy guidance together; record the decision and unresolved questions.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/experience/co: Make status, owner and next action visible to requesters and downstream service teams.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/orch: Coordinate handoffs and exception paths with explicit service ownership and recovery steps.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/rule: Version decision rules, expose review points and retain the rationale for each outcome.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/services/inte: Publish interface contracts and handle retries, failures and dependencies consistently.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/in: Define trusted records, lineage and access boundaries; validate quality at critical handoffs.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/en: Automate deployment checks and release evidence; make changes reproducible and reversible.
slots.dense-layered-architecture/foundation/op: Monitor workflow health and service reliability; connect alerts to accountable responders.
slots.slide/takeaway: Domain teams own workflow outcomes while shared services provide consistent controls and evidence.
